text: I'd like you to make some pictures of our fox mascot, using this attached fox pic as the reference. I'm quite attached to this little character, so I'm a bit nervous about it looking like a different fox from one scene to the next. What I have in mind is three separate square pictures: one of the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree. Please keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, and use the same flat cartoon style as the attached pic. I just think it would be lovely to see the mascot doing these everyday things. Please don't put any text in any of the pictures.
